description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Composite, which implements a composite validator for CSS attribute values by aggregating multiple validator objects and validating a string against them.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Composite
classes.description: A composite validator that combines multiple attribute validators and returns the first successful validation result.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the composite validator with an array of validator objects.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Iterates through the list of validators, applying each to the input string; returns the first non-false result or false if none succeed.
